status: Survey captured; subsequent joint review selected a focused Item family
question: Is a generic neutral rich-row component a recurring public design-system pattern, distinct from ListItem, selection controls, form fields and application-specific composition?
method: Purposeful comparison of official catalogues, docs and relevant source contracts. No adoption-weighted or population prevalence claim.
localFindings: Current Entity and Item implementations overlap in content placement. Bounded non-test src search found exports but no internal component consumers rendering them; docs/tests remain consumers.

rootFindings.chakra: Full pinned component export list has no general content-row Item/Entity/Row component. Core List provides list semantics/markers, with arbitrary content. Pro IntegrationListItem is application-local composition, not a Chakra core component.
rootFindings.radixThemes: Full pinned exports contain no equivalent generic rich-row component. Card docs compose Flex/Avatar/Text; DataList is key/value metadata rather than general content row.
rootFindings.material: Reuse completed full M3 Lists and actual MaterialWeb source review. ListItem is collection-specific; md-item is layout-only helper under Labs, not equivalent evidence to a stable general-purpose catalogue component.
rootFindings.proQualification: Chakra Pro IntegrationListItem/WebhookItem are application-specific compositions. Their existence supports repeated row patterns, not a public core Row component.

classificationCaution: Similarity of appearance does not establish a shared public component purpose. Multiple shadcn backends or downstream copies count once.
emergingFinding: Genuine standalone examples exist in shadcn Item and Geist Entity. MUI ListItem is technically usable standalone, despite its List-family documentation. Do not claim generic rows are absent or rare from this purposeful sample.

houseCompositionMapping.parts: Group/layout + Avatar or Icon + Text + independent actions
houseCompositionMapping.preserve: Title, optional description/metadata, flexible start/end content and footer

houseCompositionMapping.parts: List/List.Item with composed row content; optional Card/header
houseCompositionMapping.preserve: List meaning, dividers, headings and consistent presentation

houseCompositionMapping.parts: Radio Cards or Checkbox Cards + Group + optional Stat content
houseCompositionMapping.preserve: Control-owned selection/forms and individual names; secondary actions need separate valid targets

houseCompositionMapping.parts: Horizontal Field + input; optional Fieldset for related controls
houseCompositionMapping.preserve: Visible label, description/error association and control state
Action semantics without pretending it is a form field

houseCompositionMapping.parts: Text/layout, formatting/Stat where appropriate, Badge/Tag and Group
houseCompositionMapping.preserve: Wrapping/truncation, numeric presentation, arbitrary action content; exact interfaces later

mappingLimits: Conceptual mapping of inspected current docs/source, not implemented recipes or browser verification. Inventory must prove valid labels/interaction and all target layouts before migration.

findings.detail: Default div, optional ItemGroup, media/content/title/description/actions/header/footer; no collection controller. Both implementation bases count once. Docs distinguish Field.

Default and skeleton examples standalone; optional EntityList. Six complete official examples read. Underlying implementation unavailable at checked package/repository addresses; only docs and usage source verified.

findings.kind: Rich list-item family also usable standalone
findings.detail: Arbitrary children, text/avatar/icon helpers, secondaryAction; optional context, component=div. Do not exclude from neutral row evidence merely because named ListItem.
No equivalent rich-row component in inspected public exports/catalogue. Pro custom IntegrationListItem is application-local composition, not core library API.
No neutral rich-row equivalent in complete public component exports. DataList is metadata pairs. shadcn Radix-base Item is not a Radix Item component.

findings.kind: Rich List family with reusable Labs layout helper
findings.detail: Reuse completed full four-tab M3 review and source. md-item separates content presentation; List owns navigation. Labs helper differs from stable general-purpose catalogue offering.

findings.kind: Rich semantic list item; separately tablelike structured list
findings.detail: ContainedListItem li with optional button mainregion and separate action sibling. StructuredList has table/row/cell semantics and optional single selection; not exact neutral-row equivalent.
GridList state, selection, actions, navigation, virtualization and drag-drop. Not independent neutral content row.

Current v9 removes old layout-specific props; uses Persona/custom content. Optional contexts allow standalone with deliberate role, but collection behavior comes from List. Package README readiness warning conflicts with current exports/Storybook; no production certification claimed.

findings.kind: Deprecated rich-row family; successor favors composition
findings.detail: Released List deprecated; Listy since6.6.0 uses itemRender, migration composes Meta/actions/extra in JSX and header/loading/pagination outside. Five release/source docs files matched main byte-for-byte.

conclusion: Reusable rich rows have genuine precedent; their packaging is not uniform. This ten-system purposeful sample supports neither universal avoidance nor a standard mandatory generic Row. Pro app-level wrappers are not proof a public core component is needed.
interimRecommendation: Use composed examples for this house library, given selected Group/List/Field/Card and control responsibilities, with explicit inventory validation of current rich-row capabilities. Recommendation is fit-based, not a claim that row components are uncommon.
currentDecision: Focused Item selected; see item-content-family.md. Earlier composed-examples answer and interim recommendation are superseded.
